title: Reviewer failures become named categories, and a run that never answered goes red
summary: This change makes a reviewer's failure legible without ever repeating the reviewer's own text. A new `failure` module classifies a failed or timed-out reviewer's stdout/stderr into a fixed category (credential, quota, model unavailable, schema rejected, unreachable, command line, permission, unknown), and `reviewers.rs` puts only that category, the exit code and the elapsed time into the reason. The reviewer home is now always removed on drop — the `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME` escape hatch and the CI artifact uploads are gone — and every reason and context error is passed through secret redaction. `osf review run` writes its `--out` file first, then exits 2 when a reviewer made attempts and none answered, so a red job still carries its artifact. The posted verdict now follows the run's overall verdict: a run that could not run posts COMMENT, never APPROVE, and an empty lens set is could-not-run rather than a pass.

lanes.label: CI workflow
lanes.subtitle: GitHub Actions
lanes.summary: The reviewer jobs no longer keep or upload a reviewer home; each still uploads its saved answers, and the final job decides by quorum even after a red reviewer job.

lanes.label: osf CLI
lanes.subtitle: crates/osf
lanes.summary: The command that drives one reviewer, writes its run file and turns the job red when nothing answered.

lanes.label: Review core
lanes.subtitle: run, reduce, post
lanes.summary: Runs a reviewer's lenses, classifies failures, scrubs reasons, and decides the overall verdict that the posted event follows.

lanes.label: Reviewer harness
lanes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
lanes.summary: The external agent process osf spawns in a private home. Its output is untrusted text and is read only for a category.

nodes.label: review.yml
nodes.subtitle: reviewer jobs
nodes.summary: Each reviewer job drops the `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME` and `TMPDIR` environment and the 'keep this reviewer's home' artifact upload. It still uploads its saved answers, and the final `review` job runs with `always()` and decides by quorum rather than by a reviewer job's result.

nodes.label: reviewer job
nodes.subtitle: one per harness
nodes.summary: Runs `osf review run` in the review image with only its provider credential. A red job now means the reviewer tried and nothing answered, and the saved `--out` file is uploaded first so the artifact explains the red.

nodes.label: osf review run
nodes.subtitle: review_run_exit_code
nodes.summary: Writes the run file before deciding the exit code, then returns 2 when `never_answered()` is true, so the artifact is on disk even when the job goes red.

nodes.label: post_run_outcome
nodes.subtitle: --post-to
nodes.summary: Now calls `plan_review_for` with the run's own overall verdict, so the posted event follows the run rather than the findings alone.

nodes.label: review_run
nodes.subtitle: ReviewerRun
nodes.summary: Gains `never_answered()` — tried at least one attempt or hit a context error, and no attempt answered — and routes every reason and context error through `scrub_run` before the run is saved.

nodes.label: failure::classify
nodes.subtitle: Category
nodes.summary: New module. Reads a reviewer's stdout and stderr together, JSON fields first (`statusCode`, `status`, `api_error_status`, `error.type`, `error.code`) and plain-text patterns last, and returns one fixed `Category` whose wording osf owns. Harness-independent, so every agent in `AGENTS` is read the same way.

nodes.label: reviewers
nodes.subtitle: run_child
nodes.summary: Builds the failure reason from the classifier's category plus exit code and elapsed seconds, never from the reviewer's text. `RunHome` is now always removed on drop, and the `OSF_KEEP_REVIEW_HOME` path and `forget_login` are gone.

nodes.label: RunHome
nodes.subtitle: private home, removed on drop
nodes.summary: A private empty home for one reviewer run. It is removed whole on every path out of a run — answer, failure, timeout, or a command that never starts — and `remove_dir_all` does not follow a link, so a home replaced by a symlink loses the link and not its target.

nodes.label: redact_reviewer_text
nodes.subtitle: secret removal
nodes.summary: The existing secret scrub. `scrub_run` now applies it to every reason and context error in a saved run, as a last guard behind the fixed wording.

nodes.label: reducer::decide
nodes.subtitle: weighted_mean
nodes.summary: An empty lens set now yields `None` from `weighted_mean` and `CouldNotRun` from `decide`, so a review with no selected lens is never a pass at any threshold.

nodes.label: plan_review_for
nodes.subtitle: Verdict
nodes.summary: New entry point that takes the run's overall verdict. A blocking finding requests changes whatever the run said; a failed run requests changes; a could-not-run run posts COMMENT; a pass or no overall verdict approves. `Verdict` gains `Comment`.

nodes.label: answer::schema_for
nodes.subtitle: schema sent to a reviewer
nodes.summary: Strips `$schema` and `$id` from the schema handed to a harness, which some refuse when they cannot resolve the meta-schema. `trusted_location` masks any pointer segment the shipped schema does not declare, so a reviewer-chosen key — even a numeric one — never appears in a validation reason.

nodes.label: reviewer harness
nodes.subtitle: codex / claude / opencode
nodes.summary: The agent process osf spawns. Its stdout and stderr are untrusted and may hold a credential; they are read only by the classifier and never repeated in osf's output, journal, SARIF or posted review.

edges.label: osf review run
edges.summary: The job invokes the CLI with only its provider credential; the removed home-keeping environment is what changed here.

edges.label: spawn in private home
edges.summary: The CLI spawns the harness in a `RunHome` that is now always removed on drop.

edges.label: stdout + stderr
edges.summary: The reviewer's combined output is the only input to the classifier. It is read for a category and never repeated; this is the connection the change is really about.

edges.label: Category::phrase()
edges.summary: `exit_reason` and `timeout_reason` build the reason from the category's fixed phrase plus exit code and elapsed seconds.

edges.label: ReviewerRun
edges.summary: The run carries the classified reasons; `scrub_run` then passes every reason and context error through secret redaction before saving.

edges.label: never_answered()
edges.summary: The CLI writes the run file, then asks `never_answered()`; true means exit 2 with the artifact already on disk.

edges.label: overall verdict
edges.summary: `post_run_outcome` passes the run's verdict into `plan_review_for`, so a could-not-run run posts COMMENT.

edges.label: Verdict
edges.summary: The reducer's overall verdict — including the new empty-set could-not-run — is what the posted event follows.

edges.label: schema without $schema/$id
edges.summary: The schema handed to the harness no longer names a meta-schema or id, and a validation reason masks reviewer-chosen keys.

edges.label: Drop
edges.summary: The home is removed whole on every path out of a run; the keep-home escape hatch is gone.
